title: divider block props
description: A divider (« Séparateur ») between the parts of a long page: line (a thin rule, a separator for screen readers), ornament (the theme's drawing, a small mark by default), number (the number of the part, counted on the page: 01, 02…) or space (room only). Decoration: screen readers skip it, except a line, which is an <hr>.
x-ai-instructions: Use dividers to mark a pause between the parts of a long scroll page, where a heading would be too much; never one after every paragraph. A number divider opens each part of a page that has three or more (restart: true starts the count again). A part that has a name needs a heading, not a divider.

presentation.description: line: a thin rule; ornament: the theme's drawing (a small mark by default); number: the part's number, counted from the first number divider of the screen (01, 02…); space: room only.

size.description: How much room it takes above and below.
